description: This file contains test cases for CLI command parsing and behavior validation for an OpenClaw project, specifically testing functions related to argument rewriting, command registration, plugin handling, CLI path determination, and plugin configuration messages.

methods.name: rewriteUpdateFlagArgv
methods.description: Function that rewrites the '--update' flag in command-line arguments to 'update'.

methods.name: resolveMissingBrowserCommandMessage
methods.description: Generates an explanatory message if the 'browser' command is missing or disabled based on plugin configuration.

methods.name: shouldEnsureCliPath
methods.description: Determines if the CLI path should be ensured for a given set of arguments.

methods.name: shouldRegisterPrimarySubcommand
methods.description: Determines if the primary subcommand should be registered eagerly based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: shouldSkipPluginCommandRegistration
methods.description: Determines whether plugin command registration should be skipped based on context and arguments.

methods.name: shouldUseRootHelpFastPath
methods.description: Checks if the CLI should use a fast path when the root help flag is used.
